title: Understanding MSE on Test Data
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, it can affect the model's complexity. Consider how this change might impact the model's ability to generalize to new data.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding a feature can increase the model's flexibility, potentially reducing bias but increasing variance. Think about how this trade-off might influence the MSE on held-out test data.

title: Possible Outcomes for MSE
text: What are the possible effects on MSE on held-out test data when a new feature is added?
